subject.title: fix(agents): adopt orphaned managed worktrees left by a crash between git worktree add and registry insert

question: Must managed-worktree live records remain ready-only, or may this PR redefine them as claim-time records that can be incompletely provisioned?
rationale: The choice determines a persisted lifecycle contract used by sessions, Workboard, gateway, CLI, and plugin consumers; safely preserving ready-only semantics likely requires a separate reservation or an explicit migrated readiness state.

options.title: Preserve Ready-Only Records
options.body: Keep atomic ownership internally but expose the ordinary live record only after provisioning succeeds, using a separate reservation or fully handled readiness state.

options.title: Approve Claim-Time Records
options.body: Accept that live records may be incomplete, then update every consumer and recovery surface to detect and handle provisioning state explicitly.

recommendation.title: Preserve Ready-Only Records
recommendation.body: Keep atomic ownership internally but expose the ordinary live record only after provisioning succeeds, using a separate reservation or fully handled readiness state.

likelyOwner.reason: The managed-worktree lifecycle and public integration contract originated in the feature he introduced and merged.
